incidents.name: [Scheduled] Data migration maintenance
incidents.message: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of users unable to log in to Teamwork Desk in our EU region
incidents.message: We have deployed a fix for this issue in Teamwork Desk in our EU region. Limits have been put in place one one of our internal apps to avoid keeping the database too busy at peak times.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of slow downs in our US region
incidents.message: We have resolved the issue of slow response times now as response times have remained stable.

incidents.name: We are inviestigating reports of slow loading times in our US region
incidents.message: We experienced some intermittent slow downs in our US region which has passed and services are operating normally.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of users unable to log in to Teamwork Chat in our US region
incidents.message: Teamwork Chat is working normally again. We had a temporary issue a messaging queue node our apps use to talk to each other which has been resolved.

incidents.name: Connectivity issues for custom domains in the EU region
We are monitoring high load to Teamwork Chat in our US region
incidents.message: Our databases were kept busy by higher than usual traffic for Teamwork Chat, we have scaled up a little now to compensate

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of some users unable to log in in our US region
incidents.message: Some maintenance work was slowing down logins for a sub set of users which has now completed. A number of customers have responded reporting logins are responding quickly again.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of slow response times from Chat US region
We are currently investigating issues with Chat in our US region
We are investigating reports of Teamwork Desk responding slowly in both US and EU regions
incidents.message: Teamwork Desk is responding normally with no new reports of incidents from users.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of custom domains issues in our EU region
incidents.message: Our custom domain service in the EU is responding normally and we will monitor for issues.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of users being disconnected in Teamwork Chat in our US region
incidents.message: We have rolled back a deployment and Chat is responding normally now.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of slow downs for Teamwork Desk in our US region
We are investigating reports of slow downs for Teamwork Desk in our US region
incidents.message: We have identified the cause of the slow response times in Teamwork Desk in our US region. The development team have deployed an update and response times have improved significantly as a result.
